mechanism: Vedolizumab causes immunosuppression through α4β7 integrin inhibition, while isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and immunomodulatory; combined use increases infection risk and requires careful monitoring in reproductive-age patients.
action: Avoid concurrent use in women of childbearing potential due to isotretinoin teratogenicity; if unavoidable, ensure strict contraception and coordinate care; monitor for increased infection risk with immunosuppression.
